sec: Systemic complications, bad prognosis markers and syndromes

items.q: A 46-year-old female with acromegaly presents with bilateral numbness and tingling in the thumb, index, and middle fingers that awakens her at night. Which nerve compression syndrome is present?
items.exp: Carpal tunnel syndrome occurs frequently in acromegaly due to soft-tissue edema and glycosaminoglycan deposition compressing the median nerve. (Book p949)

items.q: What specific skeletal muscle histological pattern characterizes acromegalic myopathy?
opts: Hypertrophy of type-1 fibers and atrophy of type-2 fibers
Atrophy of type-1 fibers and hypertrophy of type-2 fibers
Ragged-red fibers with cytochrome oxidase deficiency
Endomysial lymphocytic infiltration with rimmed vacuoles
items.exp: Acromegalic myopathy features hypertrophy of type-1 slow-twitch fibers and atrophy of type-2 fast-twitch fibers. (Book p949)

items.q: Which systemic manifestation is NOT a recognized complication of chronic acromegaly?
items.exp: Acromegaly causes angle-closure glaucoma, OSAS, and non-malignant colonic polyps; malignant gastric carcinomatosis is not a complication. (Book p949)

items.q: What cardiac pathology is typically seen on echocardiography in patients with acromegalic cardiomyopathy?
opts: Asymmetrical concentric ventricular hypertrophy with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
Dilated cardiomyopathy with severe systolic ventricular failure
Rheumatic mitral valve stenosis with pulmonary hypertension
items.exp: Acromegaly causes asymmetrical concentric ventricular hypertrophy (CVH), CAD, and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). (Book p949)

items.q: In acromegaly, growth hormone stimulates renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase, causing hypercalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and hypercalciuria that predisposes to renal ___.
items.exp: Stimulation of 1-alpha-hydroxylase produces hypercalcemia and hypercalciuria leading to renal stones. (Book p949)

items.q: Match each letter of the DOSA bad prognosis mnemonic in acromegaly to its corresponding feature — 1) D 2) O 3) S 4) A … A) Diabetes mellitus (insulin resistance) B) OSAS (obstructive sleep apnea) C) Seborrhea D) Arthritis
items.exp: The DOSA mnemonic for high disease activity and bad prognosis denotes Diabetes mellitus, OSAS, Seborrhea, and Arthritis. (Book p949)

items.q: Assess cutaneous and thyroid changes in acromegaly: I Patients exhibit seborrhea, hyperhidrosis, and warm, doughy hands. II Thyroid enlargement (goiter) develops due to the trophic actions of elevated IGF-1.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Acromegaly produces seborrhea, hyperhidrosis, warm hands, and thyroid goiter mediated by IGF-1. (Book p949)

items.q: A 12-year-old boy presents with severe facial asymmetry. Radiographs reveal polyostotic fibrous dysplasia (PFD). He has large irregular cafe-au-lait spots, precocious puberty, and biochemical acromegaly. This syndromic constellation is:
items.exp: McCune-Albright syndrome features polyostotic fibrous dysplasia (facial asymmetry), precocious puberty, cafe-au-lait spots, and acromegaly. (Book p949)

items.q: Why do patients with acromegaly demonstrate fluid retention and hypertension?
opts: Salt and water retention mediated by aldosterone stimulation
Severe impairment of cardiac ANP peptide release
Direct activation of the collecting duct epithelial sodium channel by GH
Renal tubular insensitivity to endogenous natriuretic hormones
items.exp: Acromegaly causes salt and water retention due to aldosterone stimulation. (Book p949)

items.q: Match the macroadenoma type to its diagnostic feature — 1) Functional GH adenoma 2) Craniopharyngioma 3) McCune-Albright syndrome … A) Acromegaly with possible hyperprolactinemia B) Non-functional mass with bimodal age distribution C) Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia with cafe-au-lait spots
items.exp: GH adenomas cause functional acromegaly; craniopharyngiomas are bimodal non-functional tumors; McCune-Albright presents with PFD and skin pigmentation. (Book p949)

items.q: Insulin resistance in acromegaly is manifested clinically on the skin by velvety hyperpigmentation known as ___ nigricans.
items.exp: Insulin resistance in acromegaly produces acanthosis nigricans, hirsutism, and warm hands. (Book p949)

items.q: Assess imaging features of pituitary macroadenomas: I They demonstrate heterogeneous enhancement on contrast MRI. II Cystic components within macroadenomas do not enhance after gadolinium administration.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Pituitary macroadenomas show heterogeneous enhancement with non-enhancing cystic components and enhancing solid tissue. (Book p949)
